sources: https://reserveohio.com/OhioCampWeb/#!park/373 (ReserveOhio API: place 373, facilities 543 and 545, all units, 2027-06-15; sample sites on 2026-11-17, 2027-01-12, 2027-03-16, 2027-06-19; read 2026-10-31)

values.note: $27 a night for a site without electric; electric $37; full hookups $50. The same on a Saturday. Off-peak (November 2026 to March 2027) $23 without electric, $33 for the others. Plus tax and a $6.50 reservation fee per reservation. ReserveOhio's prices read 2026-10-31.

fees.source: ReserveOhio search/details for all units, 2027-06-15 (Campsite Non-Electric 27.00, Electric 37.00, Full Hookup 50.00, Fee 6.50); sites 23281, 23216, 23389 on Sat 2027-06-19 and off-peak dates, read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: ReserveOhio details (Electricity Hookup '20/30/50'; Sewer Hookup and Water Hookup Yes on the full-hookup sites) + https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/rocky-fork-state-park-campground, read 2026-10-31

values.note: 167 RV sites, pads 18-69 ft: 111 electric, 43 full hookup, 13 non-electric (7 of those fit 23 ft: 35, 37, 39, 54, 58, 59, 62). Lower Campground 33, Upper 134. 13 pull-throughs in the Upper Campground. Ten sites have pads under 23 ft.

sites.source: ReserveOhio search/grid and details (Pad Length, PullInTypeName), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Free WiFi for registered campers. Boat ramp and docks for campers; miniature golf.

facilities.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/rocky-fork-state-park-campground ('Showers, flush toilets, laundry facilities, dump station, and campground store'; 'Free WiFi is available throughout the campground for registered campers'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Up to six months ahead online or at (866) 644-6727. 14-night maximum on ReserveOhio.

booking.source: https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/rocky-fork-state-park-campground ('Reservations may be made up to six months in advance online or by calling (866) 644-6727') + ReserveOhio search/details (AllowWebBooking true, MaxStay 14), read 2026-10-31

note: Lower Lakeside camping area: sites 314-320 and 214-216 sit directly on Rocky Fork Lake just behind the driveway.  --AWH
summary: Fees $27 + $10 electric + $23 full hookup confirmed ($27 non-electric sites include seven that fit 23 ft); added $23/$33 off-peak. Added 50-amp/W/S, 167 RV sites to 69 ft, showers/flush/laundry/dump/store/wifi, deep link, 6-month window, 14-night max. Season (manual) left. Note: redundant RV Life line dropped.
flags: PIN 4.7 km off: 39.1852,-83.4783 is far along the lake to the east. ODNR puts the campground 'at the northwest corner of the lake'; ReserveOhio's 167 RV site coordinates centre on 39.18591,-83.53270 and the nearest is 4.35 km from the pin. Corrected coords: 39.18591,-83.53270. (Elevation 268 m was pinned at the wrong spot too.)
Phone missing: camp store (937) 393-3210 (peak season); park office (937) 393-4284, 9am-4:30pm Mon-Fri.
Website line has the park page; the campground's own page is https://ohiodnr.gov/go-and-do/plan-a-visit/find-a-property/rocky-fork-state-park-campground.

Waterfront lakefront (firsthand --AWH) supported: ReserveOhio's coordinates plot 314-320 and 214-216 at the shore of the peninsula, the east side of the Lower Campground. Upper Campground is inland. No change proposed.
No SPLIT: Upper and Lower Campgrounds are about 300 m apart on one campground road and entrance.

Winter: Lower Campground stays open and 38 Upper sites are bookable; 97 Upper sites are blocked November-March in ReserveOhio (grids 2026-11-17 to 2027-03-16). Stored season is manual and left; its note still reads true.
